title: Precision onboarding safety scaffold and regression oracle
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight yet robust safety scaffold for ingesting quantization profiles (INT8/FP8/GPTQ/AWQ) into the model-serving catalog, plus a regression oracle that detects quality/latency regressions before profiles are published. This ticket covers: profile metadata schema validation, automated stat checks (per-slice accuracy, latency distribution), canary deployment wiring, rollback signals, and pin recommendation generation. The goal is to reduce human review load while keeping false positives low and making it safe for product teams to adopt low-precision variants in production.
acceptance_criteria: Profile ingestion pipeline validates and rejects malformed artifacts with clear error messages
Regression oracle computes deterministic delta metrics vs. golden baseline and emits pass/warn/fail decisions
Canary route executes 1% of live traffic to a quant variant and collects SLO signals (p75 latency, error-rate, hallucination-score)
Automatic pin suggestion created when canary shows <1% regression across critical slices
Rollback policy triggers and routes traffic back to pinned variant within configured SLO breach window
Telemetry dashboards show per-model, per-variant breakdowns and expose RCA links
Integration tests covering ingestion -> canary -> promotion paths are added to CI
implementation_notes: Start with a JSON-LD compatible schema for profile metadata; keep schema extensible for hardware hints (AMX/GPUDirect) and kernel prefs
Use existing telemetry pipeline (metrics prefix: quant.onboard.*) and add new histograms for per-token latency and top-k quality deltas
Canary harness should reuse shadow-capture path but route 1% of traffic to variant with independent tokenization to avoid data contamination
Decision thresholds: initially conservative (p95 latency +10%, accuracy delta +1.5%) and iterate after two weeks of signal
Provide an approval webhook for PMs to quick-approve non-critical models after automated checks pass
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false negatives in regression oracle allow degraded variants to be promoted -> Mitigation: conservative initial thresholds, mandatory human sign-off for high-traffic models
Risk: telemetry volume spike from canaries -> Mitigation: sample canary traces and use delta-encoding in transport
Risk: tokenization mismatches between float and quant variants cause misleading diffs -> Mitigation: canonicalize tokenization and compare on normalized spans
Risk: rollout automation misroutes traffic -> Mitigation: dry-run mode and circuit-breaker guardrails with observable rollout state
